fb64e9d0abc2527d9638225dc276ea99edd4eed0.rationale: Historical initial blocker is documented. The legacy GitHub independent-review gate is preserved; no administrative bypass or passing independent review has been fabricated.

c855127e050d32366e1d221982fc4e5b6b32f68d.rationale: The new opt-in operator-attested-session-review mode intentionally declares its lower assurance. It does not satisfy the original requirement for cryptographically independent identity; formal adoption of the revised trust model is outstanding.

b9c61c2f42f75fa282262beefc2f84dbb24f8f68.rationale: The signed external-audit path and auditar-issue independence rules remain unchanged. The implementing conversation has not issued an independent approval of its own candidate.

92dc1c5f00e8a0b2079f33337d65251370368f82.rationale: The legacy human and signed-external paths are preserved. The added session-review mode has a different check name and is disabled by default; it cannot be substituted silently for independent approval.

95a37157a2eacc5dc53703c9f402fe5b2f01dc1c.rationale: No external signer, key custody or platform-signed ChatGPT session is provisioned or asserted. The single-operator alternative avoids those claims and requires explicit protected-base policy adoption.

1b9fd267b71cf993efd469ddee3eef01ef264e3d.rationale: Trusted-base byte comparison, immutable source collection, exact-SHA publication and revocation are implemented in scripts/verify_session_review.py. Live protected-branch activation is still outstanding.

b5a0019efab8f8135a8144580577ef0d1add6ad2.rationale: Issue/base/HEAD/merge-preview and evidence digests are validated in scripts/session_review.py. Ed25519 remains in the existing external path; the new mode explicitly does not impersonate that guarantee.

c988612ba2b757f2ea98e3bb396e5b88ce61f6a4.rationale: Focused tests cover forged identities, altered source hashes, absent/failed test bindings, edited/deleted reviews and stale targets. Tests are implementation evidence, not a real externally signed audit or completed operational rollout.

74f8095d1eff95ec79807eef20e907c3683fe9e3.rationale: Rulesets have not been weakened by this change and no merge was performed. A policy migration must be explicitly adopted and verified on a real PR; this step has not been executed.

8438bd53fa88f2a5d23bd6e21f7073ce2a34ff01.rationale: External identity and private key custody are not simulated. The new web-only, no-AI-API alternative changes the stated assurance model and remains opt-in rather than falsely satisfying this original criterion.

46ef59dc2f690957687fdcf9f4aa66b5581aad7b.rationale: An independent approved live audit and final rollout are not demonstrated. The dossier remains incomplete and must not generate certification-inputs.json or an approval claim.
